marketing_description: The Milwaukee DIAMOND MAX 4-1/2 in Tile Diamond Blade (part 49-93-9204) features a 0.063 in thick continuous rim, a 1-1/16 in arbor, and a maximum speed rating of 13,300 RPM for dry or wet cutting of ceramic tile, marble, granite and porcelain. It provides a 4-1/2 in cut width, a maximum cutting depth of 1-1/2 in, and is a Premium grade steel blade identified by its red color for use with Milwaukee angle grinders.
